title: Already familiar with Vandalizer?
description: Use this assessment-first path to demonstrate what you know. Open the relevant lessons when you need an explanation or when feedback identifies something to practise.

stages.title: Scope and approve the work
stages.purpose: Recognize agent limits, inspect the intended source and choose a workflow with the right human checkpoints.

stages.title: Verify sources and results
stages.purpose: Check extracted values, connected task outputs, arithmetic and the limits of measured quality.

stages.title: Recover and deliver
stages.purpose: Reconcile partial failures without repeating successful work, then inspect the actual deliverable and its intended destination.

stages.title: Supervise the complete task
stages.purpose: Use the governance capstone to review scope, repair flawed work, verify evidence and justify the final handoff.
